{ pkgs, fuzztest, tinycbor-src }:

pkgs.llvmPackages_19.stdenv.mkDerivation {
  pname = "tinycbor-fuzzer";
  version = "0.1.0";
  src = ./.;

  nativeBuildInputs = with pkgs; [
    cmake
    ninja
    pkg-config
    git
    llvmPackages_19.bintools
  ];

  buildInputs = [
    fuzztest
  ];

  TINYCBOR_SOURCE_DIR = tinycbor-src;

  configurePhase = ''
    cmake -S . -B build
  '';

  buildPhase = ''
    cmake --build build
  '';

  installPhase = ''
    mkdir -p $out/bin
    cp build/tinycbor_fuzzer $out/bin/
  '';
}
